grades.quote: The **`mul`** versions write the low word of the product to the destination register, while the **`mulh`** versions write the high word of the product to the destination register.
grades.reason: Says the vmulh, vmulhu and vmulhsu instructions return the high half of the 2*SEW-bit product. It also gives the signed, unsigned and signed-unsigned operand interpretations.
Gives the MULH.D (signed) and MULH.DU (unsigned) semantics. Both write the high 64 bits of the 128-bit product, product[127:64], to rd.
